blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) is on track to activate P23.5 billion worth of transmission projects this year as it works to strengthen the country’s grid network further. Breaking it down, NGCP assistant vice president Leonor Felipa Cynthia Alabanza said the grid operator is spending around P11 billion to finish projects in the Visayas; P4.5 billion on Mindanao projects; and another P8 billion on Luzon assets. READ: NGCP to complete 7 major projects in 2026 The Nabas-Caticlan-Boracay transmission line project and the Panay-Guimaras 138-kilovolt (kV) interconnection project in the Visayas will begin operations in 2026.
